ui_rectangle_select.meaning: SELECT tool creates a rectangular image-area selection from sorted pointer drag bounds; clips to bitmap, ignores empty/subpixel extents and copies selected pixels into selection image. It does not draw a rectangle outline into the image.

ui_rectangle_select.qualification: Tool caption, not imperative to select a rectangle object, not Select all. New area selection alone copies pixels without erasing them, but finishing an existing floating selection commits it. Dragging inside/handles can move, resize or rotate selected pixels after startMovingSelection erases source area with background; do not call entire selection tool non-mutating. Selecting a tool can commit pending geometry. Larger hints/options/accessibility compositions excluded.

ui_free_form_select.meaning: LASSO tool traces freehand pointer motion, closes the trace at pointer-up, computes bounds and passes path mask to the same selection routine. Canvas clips copied pixels by mask; this is selecting an arbitrary drawn outline rather than drawing a freeform line.

ui_free_form_select.qualification: Free-form concerns the shape of the area boundary, not no-cost software or unrestricted editing. Existing-selection manipulation is shared with rectangular tool. Closed trace need not be simple/nondegenerate; no quality promise. No full hint or Lock proportions acceptance inherited.

ui_bucket_fill.meaning: FILL tool fills a connected region from the touched pixel with document foreground. Pointer-up delegates to onFill, activity runs document.fill via backgroundEdit; ScanlineFill walks horizontal runs and above/below neighbours, accepting colours within squared RGBA-distance threshold from original seed.

ui_bucket_fill.qualification: Bucket is a painting-tool metaphor, not filling a physical container, whole-canvas clear, shape interior style, gradient or disconnected same-colour replacement. Tolerance zero requires exact pixel equality; positive threshold uses squared RGBA distance, not an ordinary percentage of image area. Bounds/same-colour early return and failure restoration are preserved; no guaranteed operation success. Choosing the tool is distinct from tapping to fill, though tool switch may commit prior work. No new tolerance/hint acceptance.

ui_eyedropper.meaning: PICKER tool reads the current bitmap pixel at in-bounds pointer-up coordinates and sets document.foreground. onPick adds recent colour, refreshes colours/status and schedules autosave.

ui_eyedropper.qualification: Single image-pixel colour sampling, not choosing an image/file, opening a general colour dialog, averaging a neighbourhood or automatically sampling background. No physical medical-dropper action. Sampling itself changes foreground property rather than painting pixels; switching away from a floating selection can commit that selection first.
